title: Am I Still Me?
description: It took one innocent question to spoil a family dinner.

title: It All Started with These QR FINDER Tags
description: How the first carefully designed metal tags grew into a wider system. Through the example of a free pet profile, I explain the importance of updating information, controlling what is shared and giving finders a simple way to help.

title: What If Someone Who's Gone Called You?
description: Imagine a call from someone you loved who is no longer here. You know their voice has been recreated by AI. Would it bring comfort, or make it harder to accept the loss? A fictional family story about grief, attachment and the limits of technology.

title: Introducing QR FINDER
description: The first public introduction to QR FINDER — the original idea, materials, products and the practical problem the system was created to solve.

title: The Day We Stop Saying No
description: Nobody has taken away your freedom to choose. You can still disagree with a system's advice — but you do so less and less often. When does convenience begin to replace our own judgement? An essay about responsibility and the right to say no.
